s: klI, (BAnAM rASInAM cakram । BAnAM svasvasaMsTAnaviSezErviracito golAkAraH padArTaH .) rASicakram । yaTA, -- “BramAvartto Bacakre'smin Druvo nABO vyavasTitaH । ArAcakre tvinduBOmO SukrajIvaSanEScarAH ॥ rAhuH keturagastyaSca nakzatrARyaTa rASayaH । yadA dikzu ca azwAsu merorBUgolakodBavA ॥ CAyA BavettadA rAtriH syAcca tadvirahAddinam । sUryyendoruparAgastu golakacCAyayA Bavet ॥ anyonyayostayoreva vyApayoreva kAraRAt ॥ grAsamokzO tu jAyete tatrAtaH pUrvvapaScimO ॥ tatra puRyaPalAdBAgaH kfto rAhostu vizRunA ॥” ityAdye vahnipurARe gaRaBedanAmADyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aTa BacakraBramaRavyavasTAmAha । “nirakzadeSe kzitimaRqalopagO DruvO naraH paSyati dakziRottarO । tadASritaM Ke jalayantravat sadA BramadBacakraM nijamastakopari ॥ udagdiSaM yAti yaTA yaTA narastaTA taTA KAnnatamfkzamaRqalam । udagDruvaM paSyati connataM kzitestadantare yojanajAH palAMSakAH ॥ yojanasaMKyA BAMSE 360 rguRitA kupariDihftA 4967 BavantyaMSAH । BUmO kakzAyAM vA BAgeByo yojanAni ca vyastam ॥” iti sidDAntaSiromaRO golADyAyaH ॥ (BAnAM nakzatrARAM cakramitivigrahe nakzatracakram । nakzatrasamUhaSca ॥)
v: na॰ gAnAM nakzatrARAM rASInAM vA cakram । 1 rASicakre 2 nakzatracakre ca “BramAvarto Bacakre'smin Druvo nABO vyavasTitaH । ArAcakre tvinduBOmO SukrajIvaSanEScarAH । rAhuH keturagastyaSca nakzatrARyaTa rASayaH । yadA dikzu ca azwASu merorBUgolakodBavA । kfAyA BavettadA rAtriH syAcca tadvirahAddinam । sUryyendvoruparAgastu golakacCAyayA Bavet । anyonyayostayoreva vyAsayoreva kAraRAt । grAsamokzO tu jAyete tatrAtaH pUrvapaScimO । tatra puRyaPalAdBAgaH kfto rAhIstu vizRunA” vahnipu॰ । aDikaM magolaSabde dfSyam ।
m: भ—चक्र n. the whole multitude of stars or asterisms, ib.; Var.
भ—चक्र—नाभि f. the centre of the zodiac, MW.
